reels.caption:
📌Save this video for your trip to Lapland

📍 Rovaniemi: @skyviewigloos

This unique glass igloo hotel is located just outside of the biggest „city" in Lapland. It is close to all the conveniences of normal life but you still feel like you are in the middle of nowhere. Each cabin has its own sauna, jacuzzi and glass dome.

📍 Ivalo: @auroravillage_ivalo

Aurora Village has different glass igloo accommodations and is built in a very private area. This hotel offers everything you need. All activities on-site and breakfast & incredible dinner included.

📍 Saariselkä: @auroracollectionresort

Aurora Collection Resort is located in arguably one of the most stunning places of whole Lapland - Saariselkä. The skiing center is pretty much right outside of your door. Different kind of accommodations and incredible eye for aesthetics.

📍 Ruka-Kuusamo: @lumoresort

Lumo Resort is a beautiful newly opened resort close to incredible nature. Their goal it to bring more attention to the Ruka Kuusamo area and actually show people why this place should be added to their bucket list. Rectangle glass cabins with cozy aesthetics, a lot of activities on-site & a restaurant on top.

📍 Levi: @leviniglut

Levin Iglut is one of the first real glass igloo hotels as we know them today. They are an exclusive resort on the top of a fell with perfect views to the skiing center. The igloos are very unique and you can really feel the peace there at the resort. Levin Iglut also has a really good and unique restaurant.

🤍 Which one would you pick?

reels.caption:
Still not over this hidden paradise in Hunza. 🏔️✨

@firdausresort

Tucked away in the heart of the mountains, this beautiful resort is everything you dream of for a peaceful escape. It features 3 spacious rooms, each with its own private balcony overlooking the breathtaking mountain views. Waking up here feels absolutely magical.

The cottage also has a cozy living room and a fully equipped kitchen, making it perfect for families or a group of friends looking for a home away from home.
One of my favorite parts was their restaurant, serving authentic Hunza cuisine that's full of local flavors. 🍽️ And the outdoor space is just as incredible, with lush fruit trees, a personal kitchen garden, and plenty of room to relax and soak in nature.

Hands down, one of the best stays I've experienced in Hunza. From the stunning views to the comfort, hospitality, and peaceful vibes everything was simply perfect. ❤️

If Hunza is on your travel list, make sure you don't miss this hidden gem!
